meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Zoom: announcement banner, autoplay promo videos and chat widget, plus logo strip, reviews and news card controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: rendered DOM of zoom.us home (phone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, which serve the same responsive page) and zoom.us/join (desktop), logged out, captured with headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved DOM. Fixtures real.html, desktop-real.html and desktop-join.html are structural captures with text stripped; `data-keep` marks the main content, the Join Meeting form, the Sign in and Join links and the search box.

LIVE counts: `.fdn-alert-banner` 1 (a link with role alert in the home hero), `.fdn-autoVideo` 5 (muted looping videos inside the feature tabs), `section.fdn-logo-slide` 1, `.zdcm-reviews-card` 1, `.zdcm-cs-expanded-card__wrapper` 1, `.zdcm-fdn-announcement-card-container` 1, `#livesdk__campaign` 1 on /join only (a draggable round bubble labelled Open chat dialog).

The markup uses stable component class names (`fdn-`, `zdcm-`), not hashed ones, but Zoom's CMS can rename them. The OneTrust cookie dialog was not in the captured DOM, probably because of location, so the original cookie rule is unverified here. NOT verified: logged-in web client, the web client at app.zoom.us and the in-meeting page (the rules were not tested there), pricing pages, other languages.
